{
  "classifications": {
    "1231": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text contains a specific policy commitment to invest a set amount of money in a road project (AusLink). It uses technical terms like \"implement\" and \"minimum funding\" and lacks moral language." },
    "1676": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "This text outlines an economic strategy: abolishing a tax to stimulate investment and industry. It focuses on cause and effect within the economy rather than framing the issue in terms of right, wrong, or morality." },
    "3557": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses the administrative allocation of funds to school boards and principals. It focuses on practical governance and funding distribution rather than moral arguments." },
    "3861": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "This is a short technical phrase regarding economic adjustment for a specific sector. It contains no emotive or moralizing language." },
    "5850": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes a commitment to reporting requirements, which is a procedural or bureaucratic policy. It does not contain moral rhetoric." },
    "5872": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text uses the word \"unfairly\" to describe discrimination against people from low socio-economic backgrounds. The concept of fairness is a core component of moral rhetoric." },
    "5948": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes a principle of judicial independence. While this is a democratic principle, the text states it neutrally (\"independent of the government of the day\") without using explicitly moralizing or emotive language in this fragment." },
    "6755": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text explicitly refers to \"Values\" and \"respect.\" These are abstract terms that invoke a moral framework." },
    "7577": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "This text presents a factual or statistical observation about the demographics of small business founders. It does not contain moral rhetoric." },
    "7608": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text refers to \"freedom\" and frames union actions as restricting this freedom. In political discourse, freedom is often a core moral value, and framing opponents as restricting it is a moral appeal." },
    "11352": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text prioritizes \"family reunification,\" particularly for children. Family unity and the welfare of children are concepts deeply rooted in moral and ethical values." },
    "12176": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text is a claim about economic statistics (productivity comparison between Canada and the US). It is an analytical statement, not a moral one." },
    "12796": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "This text critiques fiscal plans based on economic growth forecasts. It uses technical economic language rather than moral rhetoric." },
    "13633": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text outlines a policy to support a tourism initiative (The Gathering). It describes a program and its goals without using moralizing language." },
    "13949": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "This fragment asserts that \"evidence is clear.\" It is a rhetorical device based on empiricism rather than morality." },
    "15151": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text details a specific tax proposal for micro-enterprises. It is a technical policy description regarding tax types and feasibility." },
    "15158": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes a policy to simplify tax compliance for companies. It focuses on administrative efficiency and reducing the need for advisers." },
    "15434": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses renegotiating a financial deal to include a jobs strategy. It is a policy statement regarding economic negotiations." },
    "15896": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text is a commitment to invest in water services to reduce leakage. It focuses on infrastructure and capital budgets, not moral issues." },
    "16362": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes a process of implementing recommendations from a Forum via a White Paper. While the topic (education for all religions) relates to equality, the text focuses on the bureaucratic mechanism and provision." },
    "17686": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The phrase \"second class treatment\" implies an injustice or a lack of equality. It frames the situation not just as a policy failure, but as an unfair or wrong state of affairs." },
    "18940": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes expanding medical capacity for UN missions. It is a statement of logistical or foreign policy support." },
    "19178": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses a \"window of opportunity\" regarding resource terms and infrastructure deficits. It is an economic planning statement." },
    "19693": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes a policy to develop tourism websites and booking facilities. It is a practical initiative for tourism promotion." },
    "20059": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text introduces \"incentives\" for Affordable Housing. This is a mechanism-based policy statement rather than a moral argument." },
    "20258": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text states a goal to \"Provide broadband.\" It is a simple infrastructure commitment." },
    "20367": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text outlines a mandate for a review of anti-smoking programs. It focuses on administrative review and publication." },
    "20594": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes funding for educational materials to support teaching through the Irish language. It is a specific policy commitment." },
    "20605": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text sets out a policy for testing children in literacy and numeracy. It focuses on educational standards and assessment." },
    "22588": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses avoiding \"cost escalation\" in legal actions. It focuses on the economic efficiency of the legal system." },
    "22820": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text identifies specific road corridors (N52/N62). It is a piece of infrastructure planning." },
    "23257": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text lists transport measures (bus priority, park). It is a list of infrastructure improvements." },
    "23455": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text describes insurance costs as an \"enormous burden\" and a \"hidden tax.\" The term \"hidden tax\" implies a lack of transparency or fairness, framing the economic issue as a moral grievance against households and enterprise." },
    "24412": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses ensuring an \"efficient and accessible\" school bus system. These are functional criteria for a public service, not moral rhetoric." },
    "24434": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text mentions speeding up recommendations from a report (McIver Report). It is a procedural commitment to the education sector." },
    "24568": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text proposes amending zones and permit schemes for affordable homes. It focuses on the planning and regulatory mechanisms." },
    "25048": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text proposes capital investment in visitor attractions. It is an economic development policy." },
    "25317": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text argues for IT education to \"equip\" children for society. While it uses the word \"essential,\" the argument is utilitarian (preparation for society) rather than moralizing." },
    "25686": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text proposes reviving a council to link learning systems. It is an organizational policy for education." },
    "25792": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text proposes a statutory watchdog to improve \"accountability and standards.\" While accountability is a value, the text focuses on the regulatory mechanism for a testing body." },
    "26332": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text promotes after-school activities. It is a social policy statement regarding options for children." },
    "26592": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text uses the metaphor \"poverty trap\" and asks why the poor remain poor. It highlights the immobility and systemic unfairness of the situation, appealing to a sense of justice." },
    "26889": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text proposes a tax reduction (rates bills) for village shops. It is a specific fiscal policy to support community assets, but the language is technical." },
    "28316": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text mentions focusing on \"human rights concerns.\" Human rights are a fundamental moral concept." },
    "29054": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes the conditions of the Treaty of Waitangi (Te Tiriti) and co-operation. It is a statement regarding constitutional or historical agreement terms." },
    "29536": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text states a fact: \"We have one court system.\" It is a descriptive statement." },
    "30815": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text proposes making it easier to employ non-registered teachers with specialist skills. It is a policy regarding labor flexibility in education." },
    "32892": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text mentions exposing companies to \"private-sector discipline.\" This is economic rhetoric regarding market efficiency, not moral rhetoric." },
    "33353": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text states that water quality measurement is \"inconsistent.\" It is a technical observation." },
    "33523": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text introduces a system for processing permits for oil and gas. It is a regulatory policy." },
    "34060": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses strategies to grow exports. It is an economic/trade policy." },
    "34264": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text claims \"bureaucracy\" is preventing access to education. This frames the issue as an administrative obstruction rather than a moral failing." },
    "35144": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text references the passing of \"Three Strikes legislation.\" It is a statement of political achievement regarding law and order." },
    "36614": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text calls for support for reafforestation. It is an environmental policy point." },
    "36736": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text refers to a \"free trade agreement.\" It is a trade policy statement." },
    "37084": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text provides statistics on economic growth and forecasts. It is a factual or analytical claim." },
    "37164": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text uses the emotive verb \"smash\" to describe dealing with \"organised criminal gangs.\" While law and order is often moral, the aggressive framing of combating criminals appeals to the moral duty of protection." },
    "37533": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text mentions extending a mortgage subsidy scheme. It is a specific housing policy." },
    "37898": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses risks to health and well-being regarding a specific issue. It is a risk assessment statement." },
    "37998": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text mentions a plan to provide an \"economic base.\" It is a strategic economic goal." },
    "38294": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text states that employment of New Zealanders is a priority. It is a policy statement regarding labor markets." },
    "38427": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text calls for resourcing for mental health services. It is a health funding commitment." },
    "38545": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text refers to a \"stiffer test\" for New Zealand's interests. It is a policy stance on regulation or immigration/investment." },
    "39259": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text mentions contributing new technology. It is a fragment about innovation." },
    "40169": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The phrase \"Waiting lists are not tolerable\" expresses a moral judgment that a situation is unacceptable, rather than just inefficient." },
    "40957": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text emphasizes early intervention and health promotion. It is a health strategy statement." },
    "41040": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text mentions ensuring support for people with special needs. It is a social welfare policy commitment." },
    "41140": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text contrasts \"violence and poverty\" with \"caring and security\" and \"self-discipline.\" These are value-laden terms describing a moral transformation of society." },
    "41579": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes transport services (fast, frequent). It is a service description." },
    "41717": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text states that a gap between rich and poor \"must be closed.\" This frames inequality as an urgent problem that requires rectification, appealing to principles of equity and justice." },
    "42378": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text lists free prescriptions and eye tests for the over-60s. It is a description of a benefit entitlement." },
    "42765": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text proposes allowing businesses to employ citizens first. It is a policy regarding labor and immigration." },
    "42955": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses keeping an excise duty scheme for cider. It is a tax policy detail." },
    "45084": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text claims something is \"improving education.\" It is a statement of policy effectiveness." },
    "46125": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes a \"thriving\" economy and \"balanced growth.\" It is an economic vision statement." },
    "46317": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses using procurement policy for local growth. It is an economic strategy." },
    "46749": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text calls for strengthening school leadership. It is an education policy." },
    "46949": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text aims to \"combat loneliness,\" which frames a social/emotional issue as a challenge to be fought, implying a moral duty of care and community connection." },
    "49190": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses designing out waste. It is an environmental design strategy." },
    "49941": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text states how an MP voted on a specific tax. It is a record of political action." },
    "50782": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes the enrichment of culture by new arrivals. It is a cultural/historical observation." },
    "50786": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text describes people being \"forced\" to move because the environment can \"no longer support them.\" It highlights the severity of the humanitarian crisis caused by climate change." },
    "50848": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text explicitly mentions \"corruption\" and enforcing conventions against it. Corruption is a moral concept regarding dishonesty and abuse of power." },
    "51003": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text speaks of having the \"ingredients\" for economic success. It is a metaphorical statement about potential." },
    "51629": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses assisting the aquaculture sector. It is an industry support policy." },
    "52155": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text refers to \"civil repression.\" This is a strong moral term describing the suppression of citizens, implying an unjust or immoral context." },
    "52325": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text introduces a Food Waste Bill requiring retailers to reduce waste. It is a regulatory policy." },
    "52467": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses a sports program to keep people fit and healthy. It is a public health and recreation policy." },
    "55208": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text mentions pride in a record regarding women's representation. It is a statement of political achievement." },
    "55839": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text discusses a spending cap and balancing the budget. It is a fiscal policy statement." },
    "57031": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text uses highly emotive and moral language: \"allies in spirit,\" \"Soviet terror,\" and \"consumed so many millions.\" It frames a historical event as a battle against moral evil." },
    "57253": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text describes researchers' work as \"lifesaving.\" This attributes a high moral value and positive virtue to the activity." },
    "57394": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text uses the emotive word \"gut\" to describe plans to reduce investment. This implies a destructive and harmful action." },
    "58860": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text affirms a \"right\" to seek constitutional extension and recognizes \"valuable contributions.\" It frames the issue in terms of rights and moral recognition." },
    "58998": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text frames the issue as \"rule of lawyers\" threatening \"competitiveness\" and \"justice.\" It portrays the legal system as an antagonist denying people what they \"deserve,\" appealing to fairness." },
    "59800": { "label":  "0", "explanation": "The text describes a review of infrastructure and identification of risk sites. It is a security/administrative report." },
    "59852": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text refers to paving the way for \"societies that are free.\" Freedom is a moral value." },
    "60582": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text uses aspirational language about children becoming scientists, leaders, and poets who \"inspire.\" It appeals to the value of human potential and contribution." },
    "61223": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text states that every person has a \"place and a purpose.\" This is a statement of intrinsic human worth and dignity." },
    "62177": { "label":  "1", "explanation": "The text states that \"anger is justified.\" This validates a moral sentiment or grievance." }
  }
}
